basic_details.job_title: DAFW Member Secretary Recruitment 2027 – Apply Offline
basic_details.short_information: One post of Member Secretary in the Commission for Agricultural Costs & Prices (CACP) is to be filled on deputation (including short-term contract) basis for five years, in Level-14 (Rs. 1,44,200-2,18,200) of the Pay Matrix. Applications from eligible officers go through the proper channel to Shri Ajit Kumar, Under Secretary, Department of Agriculture and Farmers Welfare, Room No. 342, Krishi Bhawan, New Delhi-110001, within 60 days from the date of publication of the advertisement in Employment News/Rozgar Samachaar. The circular is issued by the Department of Agriculture and Farmers Welfare,

important_dates.last_date_to_apply: Within 60 days from the date of publication of the advertisement in Employment News/Rozgar Samachaar

age_limit.details: The maximum age for appointment on deputation or short-term contract shall not exceed 56 years as on the closing date of receipt of applications.

important_instructions: Applications in the prescribed format received without being countersigned by the Head of Department in the manner provided for in the format will be summarily rejected. Applications received after expiry of the last date, or without the attested ACRs/APARs, Vigilance Clearance, Integrity Certificate and statement of major/minor penalties of the last 10 years, or otherwise found incomplete, shall be liable to be rejected. For officers already on deputation, the application should be forwarded by the parent cadre/Department along with Cadre Clearance, Vigilance Clearance and Integrity certificate. Officers holding a post on deputation outside their cadre/organisation but keeping a lien in the parent cadre must give the name of the parent office and the substantive post and pay in the proforma. Pay band and grade pay granted under ACP/MACP are personal to the officer and should not be shown as the pay of the post held on regular basis; ACP/MACP details go in the separate table of the proforma. Item 17 of the proforma asks whether the applicant is applying on deputation (STC)/absorption/re-employment basis and notes that candidates of non-Government organisations are eligible only for short-term contract. The employer certifies that, if selected, the officer will be relieved immediately.

content_sections.heading: About CACP
content_sections.text: The Commission for Agricultural Costs & Prices (CACP) is described in the circular as an attached office under the administrative control of the Department of Agriculture and Farmers Welfare, Ministry of Agriculture and Farmers Welfare. The circular is issued by the department's Economics and Statistics (Estt.) Section at 342, Krishi Bhawan, New Delhi, and is dated 4 November 2026.

content_sections.heading: Where and How to Send
content_sections.text: Applications of willing, suitable and eligible officers, who could be spared in the event of their selection, are to be forwarded through the proper channel to this address: Shri Ajit Kumar, Under Secretary [Economics and Statistics (Estt.) Section], Department of Agriculture and Farmers Welfare, Room No. 342, Krishi Bhawan, New Delhi-110001 The circular does not print the Employment News publication date. Counted from the date of the circular (4 November 2026), 60 days would be about 3 January 2027 (60 days from 4 November 2026), but the actual deadline runs from the Employment News/Rozgar Samachaar publication date. The notice does not mention a postal mode or any envelope superscription. For queries, the circular gives Tel. 23383160 and E-mail ID [email protected] for the Under Secretary.

content_sections.heading: Posts, Eligibility and Pay
content_sections.text: The single Member Secretary post is open on deputation (including short-term contract) to officers from either of two groups: Holding analogous posts on regular basis; or With three years' regular service in posts in Level-13 in the Pay Matrix or equivalent (including service in a higher post), with one year's experience in the grade. Officers under the Central Government or State Governments or Universities or Agricultural Universities or Recognised Research Institutes holding analogous posts on regular basis or with three years' regular service in posts in Level-13 in the Pay Matrix or equivalent, and possessing all of the following: Ph.D. in Agricultural Economics or Agricultural Statistics from a recognised University; and Twelve years' teaching or research experience in different aspects of agriculture, including agricultural price policy, production economics, and agricultural trade policy; and Ability to apply quantitative techniques; and Experience in Government administration. The maximum age for appointment on deputation or short-term contract shall not exceed 56 years as on the closing date of receipt of applications. The post carries Level-14 (Rs. 1,44,200-2,18,200) of the Pay Matrix. The officer selected on deputation basis will have the option to draw his grade pay/level pay plus deputation (duty) allowance, or to have his pay fixed in the scale of the post, in accordance with DoPT's O.M. No. 2/22(B)/2008-Estt. (Pay-II) dated 3 September 2008, O.M. No. 2/22/2008-Estt. (Pay-II) dated 3 November 2009, O.M. No. 6/8/2009-Estt. (Pay-II) dated 17.06.2010, O.M. No. 2/11/2017-Estt. (Pay-II) dated 24.11.2017 and O.M. No. DOPT-1711629234974 dated 28.03.2024, as amended from time to time. The post is filled for a period of five years. The period of deputation, or the period of deputation including short-term contract in another ex-cadre post held immediately preceding this appointment in the same or some other organisation or department of the Central Government, shall not ordinarily exceed five years. Candidates should check the official notification for the full eligibility conditions of the post.

content_sections.heading: CACP Member Secretary Job Description
content_sections.text: The duties attached to the post of Member Secretary, Commission for Agricultural Costs and Prices, in brief, are: Perform the administrative functions of the Commission and assist the Chairman as Head of the Department in financial and administrative work of the Commission. Assist the Commission in its work relating to the Price Policy for Agricultural Commodities. Take part in the deliberations/meetings of the Commission. Advise/inform the Chairman on any issue of interest to the Commission. Accompany the Commission during field visits. Conduct research/analytical work in areas agreed to by the Commission and approved by the Chairman. Provide an interface between the Commission and the rest of the world. Supervise and guide the work of the technical Divisions of the Commission.

content_sections.heading: Enclosures
content_sections.text: Applications will be considered only when routed through the proper channel and accompanied by: Bio-data (in triplicate) in the enclosed proforma (Annexure-I). Photocopies of Annual Confidential Reports/Annual Performance Appraisal Reports of the last five years, attested (signed and stamped) on each page by an officer not below the rank of Under Secretary to the Government of India. Integrity Certificate. Certificate stating that no vigilance case is either pending or contemplated against the officer. No Penalty Certificate stating that no major/minor penalty has been imposed on the officer, or a statement giving details of major/minor penalties imposed on the officer, if any, during the last ten years. Where the applicant's organisation does not follow Central Government pay scales, the latest salary slip showing basic pay with scale and rate of increment, dearness pay/interim relief/other allowances and total emoluments may be enclosed. Separate sheets, authenticated by signature, where space in the proforma for employment details, additional information or achievements is insufficient. The proforma's employer certification asks the employer or cadre controlling authority to certify that there is no vigilance or disciplinary case pending or contemplated, that the officer's integrity is certified, that the CR dossier in original or attested photocopies of ACRs for the last 5 years are enclosed, and that no major/minor penalty was imposed in the last 10 years (or a list of penalties is enclosed).

content_sections.heading: Selection Process
content_sections.text: Selection shall be made by a Search-cum-Selection Committee duly constituted in accordance with guidelines issued by the Department of Personnel and Training. The committee has the right to shortlist candidates for the post on the basis of experience, qualifications, etc., and to call them for personal discussion. The information in the curriculum vitae, supported by documents on essential qualification and work experience, will also be assessed by the Selection Committee at the time of selection.

faq.question: Q1. How many vacancies are there in CACP Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: There is one post of Member Secretary in the Commission for Agricultural Costs & Prices (CACP).

faq.question: Q2. What is the last date for the CACP Member Secretary application?
faq.answer: Applications must be forwarded within 60 days from the date of publication of the advertisement in Employment News/Rozgar Samachaar. Applications received after the last date are liable to be rejected.

faq.question: Q3. What qualification is needed for CACP Member Secretary?
faq.answer: IES/ISS officers holding analogous posts or with three years' regular Level-13 service (with one year in the grade) can apply. Other Government, University or Recognised Research Institute officers need analogous or Level-13 service plus a Ph.D. in Agricultural Economics or Agricultural Statistics, twelve years' teaching or research experience, ability to apply quantitative techniques and experience in Government administration.

faq.question: Q4. What is the age limit for CACP Member Secretary?
faq.answer: The maximum age for appointment on deputation or short-term contract shall not exceed 56 years as on the closing date of receipt of applications.

faq.question: Q5. What is the salary of CACP Member Secretary?
faq.answer: The post is in Level-14 (Rs. 1,44,200-2,18,200) of the Pay Matrix. A deputationist may draw his grade pay/level pay plus deputation (duty) allowance, or have pay fixed in the scale of the post as per DoPT orders.

faq.question: Q6. How do I apply for CACP Member Secretary?
faq.answer: Fill the Annexure-I bio-data proforma in triplicate, attach the listed certificates and APARs, get it countersigned by the Head of Department and forward it through proper channel to Shri Ajit Kumar, Under Secretary, Room No. 342, Krishi Bhawan, New Delhi-110001.

faq.question: Q7. How will the CACP Member Secretary be selected?
faq.answer: A Search-cum-Selection Committee constituted as per DoPT guidelines will make the selection. It may shortlist candidates on the basis of experience, qualifications, etc., and call them for personal discussion.

faq.question: Q8. Is the CACP Member Secretary post permanent?
faq.answer: No, the post is filled on deputation (including short-term contract) basis for a period of five years.

faq.question: Q9. Can an application be sent directly without the employer's countersignature?
faq.answer: No. Only applications routed through the proper channel are considered, and applications not countersigned by the Head of Department in the manner given in the format will be summarily rejected.
